Chapter 731 - 731 It Works; Conspiracy!

Chapter 731 - 731 It Works; Conspiracy!

731 It Works; Conspiracy!

The palm that blotted out the sky instantly wrapped around the three warships.

“Whoosh!”

Instantly, the three battleships emitted strands of starlight.

In the end, it dissipated into nothingness.

At this point, the void returned to peace.

Lin Fan turned around and returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

….

The Second Brigade.

” C2018 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 7981, 135, 189, planet discovered…”

” C2018 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 7981, 135, 189 planet has been successfully occupied…”

….

One report after another was sent in and tabulated.

At this moment, an urgent report was sent back.

“Beep! The X201, X301, and X401 battleships had successfully arrived at coordinates 5901, 234, and 199.”

After the notification sounded, everyone in the Second Brigade focused their attention.

Because not long ago, a warship had been destroyed in this position.

Now, three X-series warships were dispatched to deal with the situation.

They were all looking forward to the next change.

“Beep! The captain of the X301 warship sent back a document and found a suspected target.”

“Beep! The X301 warship’s captain sent back a document. The target was extremely dangerous.”

In the next moment…

“Beep! The signals of the X201, X301, and X401 warships were lost.”

“Beep! The signals of the X201, X301, and X401 warships were lost.”

One voice after another echoed in the stadium.

Soon, a clamor broke out at the scene.

“What is it? Three X-series warships lost their signals? This is impossible!”

“Those are three X-series warships. How can they all lose their signals?”

“Hurry up and call!”

“There must be a problem!”

….

Hence, the Second Brigade took the initiative to search and call out.

However, there was no reaction at all.

After a long time, everyone finally admitted that the X201, X301, and X401 battleships had all been destroyed!

Everyone’s faces were filled with disbelief.

At this moment, the captain sitting in the upper seat said,””Before attacking the Spring Region, our Ocean Universe had already made a prediction. The Four Seasons Universe might withdraw from the Spring Region and guard against the Autumn Region and the Winter Region.”

“Or perhaps, we can gather a powerful force somewhere in the Spring Domain to counterattack.”

“From the looks of it, coordinates 5901, 234, 199 are very likely to be one of the counterattacks of the Spring Territory.”

” This is not something that the Second Team can solve. Report it to the Ocean Universe Center!”

….

In fact, during the attack, the ocean universe also encountered other counterattacks.

They would all be dealt with by the great beings sent by the center of the ocean universe, and it would take a certain amount of time.

This meant that Earth would not be disturbed for a short period of time.

Time flew by like water.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

In the past five years, Lin Fan had obtained three Transcendence Golden Bodies, two Immortal Crystals, one King grade equipment, and one Heaven and Earth Enlightenment from the system.

Under the effects of the massive amount of pure Spirit Qi, coupled with the aid of the Heaven and Earth Enlightenment, Lin Fan’s cultivation state had reached King level 6. He was extremely powerful.

However, he was still dissatisfied.

He had to vent his dissatisfaction.

And so, Lin Fan cursed Tai Jun once more.

As soon as he finished cursing, a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Your enemy, Tai Jun, has been greatly affected by your curse. He is seriously injured and is in danger.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he broke out into a smile.

“Is the curse finally working? My persistence every day was not in vain.”

….

In the distant starry sky, in the Myriad Demon Sect.

Tai Jun had never left the palace all these years.

He said to the outside world that he was in seclusion to comprehend the cultivation technique.

In reality, he had been resisting the power of the curse.

Even though the Sage had given him a magic treasure.

However, as time passed.

Tai Jun realized that the power of the curse was getting stronger and stronger, and in contrast, the effect of the magic treasure was getting smaller and smaller.

He was fighting against the curse every day. If he relaxed a little, he would fall into eternal damnation.

Tai Jun blamed all of this on the demonic sect.

Therefore, over the years, he had been constantly increasing his encirclement and suppression of the demonic sects.

He wanted to force the Demon Sect Master out and kill him.

Only by solving the problem from the source could he be free.

However, the Demon Sect Master was like a coward and did not show his face.

This made Tai Jun extremely helpless.

And today…

“Kacha!”

Cracks suddenly appeared on the magic treasure he was using to resist the curse.

In the end, it shattered like a bubble.

“Whoosh!”

The pitch-black power of the curse instantly covered Tai Jun’s entire body like a tidal wave.

“Puff!”

Then, Tai Jun’s mouth, nose, eyes, ears…Blood spurted out like a pillar, and they became extremely ferocious and terrifying.

“Roar!”

Tai Jun roared into the sky, his voice shaking thousands of miles, scaring countless living beings into trembling and spitting out a large mouthful of blood.

Instantly, his entire body deflated like a balloon, becoming extremely dispirited.

His bloody face was filled with madness and ruthlessness.

“From now on, my Ten Thousand Demon Sect and the Demon Sect will not rest until one of us dies!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Tai Jun suddenly soared into the sky. His entire person was like a balloon in the sky that suddenly exploded.

In an instant, the area within a million kilometers was dyed red.

It was extremely terrifying.

Tai Jun, die!

The disciples of the Thousand Demons Sect were stunned.

Then, they all knelt on the ground.

“Greetings, Sect Master!”

“I’m irreconcilable with the Demon Sect!”

“Demon Slayer Sect, Demon Slayer Master!”

“Kill the Demon Sect!”

….

Shouts of battle resounded throughout the world.

All the Myriad Demon Sect disciples ‘eyes turned red. As long as the Demon Sect appeared, they would immediately kill them.

In fact, it wasn’t just the Ten Thousand Demons Sect.

The Water God Palace, Lightning Sect, and other large factions also increased their attacks on the demonic sects.

This was because in such a short period of time, the Fire God Palace Lord and the Myriad Demon Sect’s Sect Master had both died, making them feel fear.

This power was too terrifying.

Especially… This kind of power was still in the hands of the enemy.

All of a sudden, the days of the fiend sects became more and more difficult.

….

The demonic sect hidden in the darkness.

All the higher-ups gathered together, and the atmosphere was a little gloomy.

“In the past few days, nearly a quarter of the hidden forces of our Demon Sect have been uprooted. “Now, all the factions that have a trace of ties with the Demon Sect have taken the initiative to stand up and draw a clear line with us.”

As soon as he said this, the atmosphere became even more depressing.

“Demon Sect, do you really not know how to curse?”

Everyone’s gazes focused on the Demon Sect Master.

The Fire God Palace Lord and the Myriad Demon Sect’s Sect Master both insisted that the Demon Sect Master had cursed them to death.

How could this not be suspicious?

“I really don’t know how to curse. At the very least, there was absolutely no curse that could kill an Emperor-level powerhouse.”

He also wanted to possess such power.

If there was, why would the Demon Sect be afraid of enemies?

Those who did not submit to him would all be cursed to death!

Who exactly was it? Why did they pin this matter on him?

The Demon Sect Master vaguely felt that a huge conspiracy was slowly unfolding towards him.
